left.raw_text: - Signed consent obtained before any study-related activities (study-related activities are any procedure related to recording of data according to the protocol)

- The decision to initiate treatment with commercially available NovoMix 30 has been made by the patient and the treating physician before and independently from the decision to include the patient in this study
- Male or female, greater than or equal to 19 years at the time of signing informed consent
and treated with basal insulin plus 1-3 bolus insulin injections per day for at least 24 weeks prior to informed consent

right.raw_text: - Available and documented HbA1c value less than or equal to 12 weeks prior to initiation of NovoMix 30 treatment
